positive.prompt: Refine Jira task có ý tưởng thô mơ hồ thành spec chi tiết rõ ràng
Làm rõ requirements mài giũa spec và push lại lên Jira
Tư duy phân kỳ hội tụ để mài giũa Jira task thiếu chi tiết

evals.prompt: Refine Business-Spec với incomplete user stories và missing acceptance criteria
evals.expected_output: Updated Business-Spec với complete user stories, detailed acceptance criteria, và resolved ambiguities
expectations: Incomplete user stories completed (As a, I want, So that)
Missing acceptance criteria added (Given, When, Then)
Open questions from previous version resolved
Confidence level improved from previous version
Gate 2 enforces explicit user approval before pushing (PUT) spec to Jira Description and backs up current description

evals.prompt: Refine Business-Spec dựa trên feedback từ DEV và QA (missing API details, unclear validation rules)
evals.expected_output: Updated Business-Spec addressing all feedback with added technical details
expectations: Validation rules clarified with BVA tables
Change log documenting what was refined
